title.romaji: Jigoku Sensei Nube: Gozen 0-toki Nube Shisu
title.english: Hell Teacher Nube: 0 a.m. Nube Dead
title.native: 地獄先生ぬ～べ～　午前０時ぬ～ぺ～死す！
title.kazakh: Тозақ мұғалімі Нубе: сағат 0.00 Нубе өлді
title.kk: Тозақ мұғалімі Нубе: сағат 0.00 Нубе өлді

description: New student comes to Nube class. His name is Jun and he's a lonely boy who loves clowns very much. His only friend is a Pierre - clown in the mirror. And one night Pierre gives Jun a mask with strange abilities. At that point Jun starts to act strange and lot of accidents occur in the school.
